title: A largest perfectoid-purity center and normal quotient for perfectoid-pure complete local rings with perfect positive-characteristic residue field
author: Anne Fayolle
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 12 (2025), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.313
difficulty_reason: The formal existence of a maximal compatible ideal does not by itself supply a canonical center with a normal quotient in mixed characteristic. The author develops compatibility under perfectoidization and quotient maps, proves independence from the chosen regular presentation, and shows that the normalization conductor is uniformly compatible. Those new transfer/conductor arguments close purity detection, canonical splitting-prime maximality and normality beyond the precise prior perfectoid/prism foundations.
